data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'ballas' meaning 'vow' or 'promise'. The name Ballard was given to those who kept their vows and showed courage in protecting their people. In Christianity, Ballard is associated with St. Ballard, a 6th-century saint who was a shepherd and kept his flock safe from harm. The name Ballard carries the meaning “Courageous Guardian” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ballard usually hope their child will grow to embody courageous guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
